# Context-Rich Solid Mechanics Problem

## Shear and Bending-Moment Analysis of a Hydraulically Supported Industrial Robot Arm

### Engineering Context

A manufacturing facility uses a hydraulically actuated manipulator to lift and position heavy ring-shaped components. During inspection or assembly, the arm may remain stationary while carrying a payload. The horizontal arm is then subjected to its distributed self-weight and gripper weight plus a concentrated payload at the end.

The structural-analysis team needs the internal shear-force and bending-moment demands along the arm before detailed stress or section-sizing checks are performed.

![Industrial hydraulic manipulator holding a metal ring component.](assets/robot-arm-industry-context.png){fig-alt="Hydraulic industrial manipulator with a horizontal arm holding a heavy circular metal component." width=88%}

### Main Engineering Goal

Determine the hydraulic-cylinder force and pin reactions required for equilibrium, construct the shear-force and bending-moment diagrams, and identify the location and magnitude of the absolute maximum bending moment.

### System Components

- horizontal robot arm and gripper ABC;
- pin connection at A;
- hydraulic cylinder BD;
- gripper and payload at C;
- robot body, base, and floor support.
